payload.title: Basic manipulation of `pylipd.LiPD` objects
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to manipulate `pylipd.LiPD` objects for paleoclimate data analysis. It covers extracting time series data from LiPD formatted datasets, working with multiple datasets, and removing or popping datasets from a `LiPD` object. The notebook uses datasets from Nurhati et al. (2011) and the PAGES2k Consortium (2017) to illustrate these processes. The primary goal is to facilitate the analysis of paleoclimate data by leveraging the `pylipd` library.
